title: Maintenance — Legacy investigation
description: Read-only investigation workflow for legacy/system behavior: trace execution flow and produce actionable investigation notes for the team.

steps.title: Find entry & callers
steps.notes: From the file/symbol the user asked about; expand via references. Write/update .vibe/research/<task-id>.md with paths and observed call flow.

steps.title: Summarize behavior & assumptions
steps.notes: Record hidden constraints, side effects, and tech debt in .vibe/research/<task-id>.md — no refactor in this step unless requested.
verify_commands: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path');const root=process.cwd();const active=path.join(root,'.vibe','active.json');const legacy=path.join(root,'.vibe','state.json');let st;if(fs.existsSync(active)){const p=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(active,'utf8'));const seg=p.session_segment;if(!seg||typeof seg!=='string'){console.error('Invalid .vibe/active.json');process.exit(1);}const sp=path.join(root,'.vibe','sessions',seg,'state.json');if(!fs.existsSync(sp)){console.error('Missing session state: '+sp);process.exit(1);}st=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(sp,'utf8'));}else if(fs.existsSync(legacy)){st=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(legacy,'utf8'));}else{console.error('No Vibe state: expected .vibe/active.json + .vibe/sessions/<segment>/state.json, or legacy .vibe/state.json');process.exit(1);}const id=String(st.task_id||'').replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9._-]+/g,'_');const f=path.join(root,'.vibe/research',id+'.md');if(!fs.existsSync(f)){console.error('Missing research file: '+f);process.exit(1);}const b=fs.readFileSync(f,'utf8');const required=['Sources','Confirmed vs Assumptions','Ambiguities & questions'];const missing=required.filter((h)=>!new RegExp('^#{1,6}\\s*'+h+'\\s*$','im').test(b));if(missing.length){console.error('Investigation notes missing sections: '+missing.join(', '));process.exit(1);}if(!/(investigation summary|legacy summary|impact|next step|risk)/i.test(b)){console.error('Add an investigation summary with impact/risks/next steps to the research file.');process.exit(1);}"
